_readme: PLACEHOLDER PRICES. There is no GLS contract yet. Replace every price before launch.
A parcel is chosen by bottle count AND total weight (product weight_kg in products.json).
The smallest parcel that fits both limits is used. Orders larger than the biggest parcel
are split into several of the biggest parcels plus one parcel for the rest.
EU countries only. Remove a country from its zone to stop shipping there.
Local pickup is free and offered only for the countries listed in pickup_countries.
